PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.MapBrowser.Title: Map Browser
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.MapBrowser.Hint: Click a map to create a scene, or drag it onto the Scene Express drop zone in the Scenes tab.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.MapBrowser.KeybindingHi: Opens the battlemap search window (or brings it to the front if already open).
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.MapBrowser.SceneExpress: Scene Express must be installed and enabled to create scenes from the Map Browser.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.SharedTimer.Heading: Shared Timer
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.SharedTimer.NoGM: No GM connected: cannot sync the timer.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.SharedTimer.PlayersCont: If enabled, players can create, pause, extend or stop the shared timer. Otherwise only the GM controls it (players just see it).
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.NimbleCalc.Title: PF2e -> Nimble Calculator
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.NimbleCalc.OverBudget: Even at level 1/4, {n} creatures exceed the budget of {budget}.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.NimbleCalc.WarnOverBudg: Reduce the number of creatures, or turn the extra ones into minions (off budget).
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.NimbleCalc.BossNeedsTwo: Boss + minions mode needs at least 2 creatures.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.NimbleCalc.BossNoRoom: 1 level {level} boss: only {rest} level(s) left for {n} minions (min. 1/4 each).
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.NimbleCalc.WarnBossNoRo: Lower the boss share, cut minions, or turn them into minions (off budget).
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.NimbleCalc.WarnTooManyC: More than 4 creatures per hero: Nimble recommends 1-4 (minions excluded).
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.NimbleCalc.WarnSingleCr: A single big creature: consider a Nimble legendary monster.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.NimbleCalc.WarnVeryDead: Very deadly: reserved for when players ignored a telegraphed danger.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.DropActorFolder.Subfold: If enabled, dropping an actor folder onto the scene also places the actors of its subfolders.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.DropActorFolder.Confirm: Ask for confirmation before creating more than N tokens at once. 0 never asks.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.DropActorFolder.NoPermi: You do not have permission to create tokens.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.Torch.Tooltip: Left click: light / Right click: extinguish
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.Torch.NothingLit: No light lit by the torch button on this token.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.Torch.Title: Light source
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.Torch.Failed: Could not update this token's light.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.Torch.WarnGlobalLight: Global illumination is enabled on this scene: the token light will not show. Disable it in the scene configuration (Lighting tab).
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.Torch.WarnBrightScene: This scene is barely darkened: raise its darkness level to see the token light.
TOOL_SHORTCUT.SlotHint: Activates the control group at this position in the list actually displayed on screen (controls hidden by other modules are ignored).
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.NoTokenAnimation.Name: Disable token movement animations
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.NoTokenAnimation.Hint: Tokens jump straight to their destination instead of sliding. Client-side only: it changes nothing for the other players.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.NoteIconBackground.Name: Hide the dark backdrop behind map notes
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.NoteIconBackground.Hint: Map note markers are drawn without their dark rounded square. The marker, its hover border and its click area are unchanged.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.EscapeActiveWindow.Name: Escape closes only the active window
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.EscapeActiveWindow.Hint: Escape closes the front-most window instead of every open window at once. Press it again to close the next one. Everything else Escape does (cancel a drag, close a context menu, deselect tokens, open the main menu) is unchanged.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.EscapeActiveWindow.Keyb: Only acts while the setting of the same name is enabled. Otherwise Foundry's default behaviour applies.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.TokenNotes.DelayHint: How long a token must be hovered before its note appears, in milliseconds. Zero shows it instantly, at the cost of a panel flickering whenever the cursor crosses the canvas.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.TokenNotes.PromptEmptyN: Token notes: offer to write on tokens without a note
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.TokenNotes.PromptEmptyH: Hovering a token that has no note still opens the panel, with a prompt to click. Disable to only show the panel on tokens that already have a note: the canvas is quieter, but there is no longer a way to write a first note from hover.
Applies to every token of this sheet
Applies to this placed token only
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.TokenNotes.DropFailed: Could not create a link to that document.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.Generators.Title: Generators
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.Generators.KeybindingHi: Opens the generators window. If it is already open, rerolls the active generator.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.Generators.JournalFaile: Could not create the journal page.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.Generators.JournalCreat: Page "{name}" added to the Generators journal.
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.Generators.Names.Title: Names
PERSONAL_TOOLBOX.Generators.Names.CopyHi: Click a name to copy it
